actions.action: Move plant to a south- or west-facing window
Alternatively set up a grow light for 10-12 hours a day
Behead the rosette leaving 1-2 inches of stem and strip lower leaves
Let cutting callus for several days
Set cutting on dry cactus mix and water lightly once roots form
Keep old stump in bright light and water sparingly to sprout new rosettes
Propagate fallen or twisted-off leaves on well-draining soil
Repot into terracotta pot with gritty cactus mix plus perlite or pumice
Water thoroughly only when soil is completely dry

reason: The answer correctly identifies etiolation as the main problem, and its core advice (more light, beheading, re-rooting, and leaf propagation) closely matches the fix that worked, with nothing likely to harm the plant.
